compile_all_poj104_programs: compile all 52000 POJ-104 C++ programs in parallel using the POJ104Dataset compile_all method
preprocess_poj104_cpp_source: preprocess a POJ-104 C++ source string to fix main signatures and add standard library headers
create_poj104_dataset_instance: create a POJ104Dataset instance with a site_data_base path to access 52000 C++ algorithm programs
benchmark_from_parsed_uri: resolve a BenchmarkUri to a compiled LLVM bitcode benchmark from POJ-104 C++ source on demand
create_legacy_poj104_dataset: create a deprecated POJ104LegacyDataset instance for the v0 benchmark dataset with precompiled bitcode files
